name: tanstack-start-host
title: TanStack Start Host

origin.source: TanStack Start server functions calling runAgent; a bootable workspace app on real `@tanstack/react-start`, so createServerFn is the published builder and CI catches API drift

comparison.purpose: Controlled mode in server functions: startAgent runs a machine to idle/done and persists the snapshot; resumeAgent delivers the human event to finish the run.

starters: The v2.0 release with dark mode
